note: Provider registry. Each capability resolves to an adapter in lib/providers/. Swap a provider by changing `active` - no workflow or business logic changes. Adapters share one interface per capability so a replacement only implements that interface.

manual_csv.note: Drop a CSV in the import webhook. Useful for testing the whole pipeline without spend.

custom_http.note: Any replacement scraper that can answer a POST with the RawLead shape.

graph_api.note: Business Discovery endpoint - only for accounts your app is permitted to read.

website_scrape.note: About/Team/Contact page parse. Always runs when Apollo returns nothing - a missing contact never discards a lead.

ai.interface: complete({ prompt, schema, model, maxTokens }) -> object

mock.note: Deterministic fixtures for tests and dry runs.

datastore.interface: Postgres over REST or direct connection

postgres.note: Same migrations - Supabase is only a hosting choice.

google_sheets.note: One-way mirror of qualified leads. The database stays the source of truth.

instagram_messaging.interface: send(threadRef, message, ctx) -> SendResult | { manual: true }

manual.note: DEFAULT. The approval console hands the operator the approved text and the profile link; the operator sends it in Instagram and confirms. The system logs the send. This is the compliant path for cold outreach.

graph_api.note: Official Instagram Messaging API. It can reply inside an open conversation window - it cannot initiate cold DMs, and this system does not pretend otherwise.

graph_webhook.note: Official messages webhook for your own professional account. Preferred when available.

manual.note: Operator pastes the reply into the console; identical downstream handling.
